events.subtitle: The Yours Sincerely Tour — with special guest Toro y Moi

priority_review.rationale: Concrete scarcity is the U.S. routing: an authoritative tour presenter describes this as Haruomi Hosono's first U.S. tour in seven years and announces only New York and Los Angeles, making September 16 the sole East Coast performance. The Radio City date also lands five days after the worldwide release of Yours Sincerely and bills Toro y Moi as special guest. A+ was explicitly challenged and judged insufficient: for a major living Japanese master with a seven-year gap between U.S. tours, waiting for another nearby date could realistically mean years, so missing the corridor's only announced East Coast night would plausibly create genuine regret. S+ is not warranted because the same tour continues to Los Angeles on September 20 and Hosono remains actively performing in Japan, so this is rare access rather than a singular farewell or historically unique last opportunity.

events.factual_description: Radio City Music Hall presents Haruomi Hosono: The Yours Sincerely Tour on Wednesday, September 16, 2026. The official venue page lists doors at 19:00 and the performance at 20:00 and bills Toro y Moi as special guest. Sony Music Japan confirms that Hosono's twenty-third studio album, Yours Sincerely, is scheduled for worldwide release on September 11 and identifies September 16 at Radio City Music Hall and September 20 at the Greek Theatre in Los Angeles as the U.S. tour dates, with Toro y Moi guesting at both. Nederlander Concerts describes the run as Hosono's first U.S. tour in seven years and says the tour consists of performances in New York and Los Angeles. No face-value ticket price or backing-band personnel for the Radio City performance is stated in the verified sources checked for this batch, so none is inferred.

en.why_it_matters: Hosono rarely gives the U.S. this kind of access: his first American tour in seven years is only two announced dates, and New York is the sole East Coast stop, arriving five days after a new album. Radio City turns a new-record cycle into a rare stateside encounter with one of the living architects connecting Japanese pop, electronic music, folk memory and cosmopolitan songcraft; Toro y Moi on the bill makes that generational line visible without turning the night into nostalgia.
en.trip_verdict: From the DMV, this is one of the New York nights worth making a dedicated regional trip for rather than waiting for a closer routing that may not come. I would secure the New York plan early and let Radio City anchor the day.

es.why_it_matters: Hosono rara vez ofrece este tipo de acceso en Estados Unidos: su primera gira por el país en siete años tiene sólo dos fechas anunciadas, y Nueva York es la única en la Costa Este, apenas cinco días después de la salida de un disco nuevo. Radio City convierte ese ciclo de obra nueva en un encuentro poco común con uno de los arquitectos vivos que conectaron el pop japonés, la electrónica, la memoria del folk y una idea cosmopolita de la canción; la presencia de Toro y Moi hace visible esa línea generacional sin volver la noche un ejercicio de nostalgia.
es.trip_verdict: Desde el DMV, ésta sí es una de esas noches de Nueva York que justifican una subida regional dedicada, en vez de esperar una fecha más cercana que quizá no llegue. Cerraría pronto el plan de Nueva York y dejaría que Radio City ancle el día.
